q: How does a cable maker count Zambian copper cathode in Scope 3?
title: Zambian copper cathode in Scope 3
short: Multiply tonnes bought by a per tonne footprint for that producer, cradle to gate. Copper is not a CBAM good, so this is Scope 3 only. Ask whether the figure covers mining, smelting and refining, and which year's grid power it uses.
audience: Cable, wire and tube makers in India, Asia and Europe buying Zambian copper

ul: CO2 per tonne of cathode and the boundary.
Share from diesel, grid power and smelting fuel.
Whether sulphuric acid by product got a share.

p: Purchase invoices with tonnes and the producer on each lot, so the right figure attaches to each delivery.
Use a database average and say so. Producer data usually replaces it within a reporting cycle once you ask.

senseible: Senseible turns supplier invoices into a Scope 3 record with the supplier, quantity and factor behind every figure, so you can see which supplier data is still missing.
